description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page for configuring local IP settings, including IPv4 and IPv6 network parameters, DHCP settings, and related network configurations. It includes embedded JavaScript for form validation and dynamic UI behavior.

methods.name: updateIPv4
methods.description: Updates IPv4 address range inputs based on subnet mask selection.

methods.name: initPopulateDHCPv4
methods.description: Initializes DHCP IPv4 address range inputs based on current subnet mask.

methods.name: validate_v4addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that DHCP beginning address is less than or equal to ending address.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Converts lease time value and unit into seconds.

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Displays lease time in appropriate units and updates form fields.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of segments.

methods.name: updateIPv6
methods.description: Enables or disables IPv6 address input fields based on checkbox state.

methods.name: stateful_check
methods.description: Toggles ULA prefix input visibility based on IPv6 stateful/Stateless selection.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that DHCPv6 beginning address is less than or equal to ending address.
